MPC_ENGINEERING.title: MPC Stream (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry)
MPC_ENGINEERING.summary: Gateway for engineering, applied computing, architecture, and mathematical sciences.
highSchoolFocus: Maths 1A/2A: Functions, Matrices, Complex Numbers, Probability & Calculus
Maths 1B/2B: Coordinate Geometry, Differentiation & Integration
Physics: Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Optics & Modern Physics
Chemistry: Physical, Inorganic & Organic Chemistry

exams.name: State EAPCET / EAMCET (Engineering)
exams.qualifying: Minimum 40/160 marks (25%) for General/BC. Ranked irrespective of marks for SC/ST.

safetyNet.title: Accessible & High-Demand Alternatives (Low/Borderline Score Friendly)
recommendations: B.Sc Computer Science / Data Science / IT via direct degree counseling (AP OAMDC / TG DOST) — No entrance rank pressure, focuses directly on software skills.
BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) — Emphasizes coding, web development, and software tools rather than abstract physics/calculus.
Direct Admission / Management Category in affiliated private engineering institutes.
1-2 Year Technical Certifications: Full Stack Web Development, Cloud Support, or Networking (CCNA/AWS) to launch tech careers directly.

BIPC_MEDICINE.title: BiPC Stream (Biology, Physics, Chemistry)
BIPC_MEDICINE.summary: Targeted pathway for clinical healthcare, pharmaceuticals, agricultural sciences, and life sciences.
highSchoolFocus: Botany: Plant Physiology, Morphology, Diversity, and Genetics
Zoology: Human Anatomy, Physiology, Animal Diversity, and Evolution
Physics & Chemistry: Standard medical weightage curriculum

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.qualifying: 50th percentile (~135-140 marks out of 720 for General).

safetyNet.title: Practical Healthcare & Allied Science Alternatives
recommendations: B.Sc in Medical Lab Technology (BMLT), Radiology, or Operation Theatre Tech — Immediate hospital jobs with minimal entrance competition.
B.Sc Biotechnology / Microbiology / Food Technology via direct degree counseling (OAMDC / DOST).
D.Pharmacy (2-Year Diploma in Pharmacy) — Shorter duration, lower entry barrier, grants a registered pharmacist license.
B.Sc Nursing — High domestic and global healthcare workforce demand.
